conclusion: Frozen-H2 baseline, density-stratified error diagnosis and NPZ-internal label review complete.
scope: Train-main density reference plus Train-dev diagnosis; no training, Validation or Test

density_reference.definition: high-density sequence iff event_rate_eps >= Train-main sequence q75

H2-R.reason: max IoU, then lower Fa, higher Recall, lower threshold

event_ap_definition: event average precision; not bounding-box mAP

label_review.selection: 5 top FN, 5 non-overlapping top FP, 5 fixed-seed random windows
label_review.automatic_scope: NPZ internal consistency, track/event geometry and H2 error overlays
label_review.semantic_status: requires original annotations or explicit human judgment
